current_case.current_release_boundary: PASS_EVENT_RESEARCH_ONLY; non-rating and expires when formal 2026H1 report is released

classification_definitions.immediately_completable: Can be prepared from current filings, archived market data, original broker PDFs, or publicly available sources. It cannot create house FY EPS, target price, upside, or rating before formal H1.
classification_definitions.only_after_formal_H1: Formal H1 is a necessary input. It is not sufficient if segment, unit-economics, customer/order, or cash-conversion disclosure remains inadequate.
classification_definitions.industry_not_applicable: Literal China Shipbuilding sector-specific fields should not be copied to Yahua. Only the driver-to-cash-to-valuation-control method transfers.

overall_conclusion.finding: Yahua's missing house EPS, target price, upside, and rating are correct for its pre-formal-H1 event-research mandate, not a mechanical deficiency against a full-note template.
overall_conclusion.full_note_rule: Do not silently relabel the current event study. Formal H1 must initiate a new full-note contract and R0-R4 lifecycle; unresolved unit-economics or cash gaps require watchlist only / insufficient evidence.

gaps.reference_requirement: The reference brief, gate manifest, and contract define a 40-60-page single-stock full research note and require evidence, full-chain, broker, model, valuation, secondary-market, and IC-readiness gates.
gaps.yahua_status: Current brief, manifest, and contract intentionally define an earnings-preview event study with no house FY EPS, target, upside, or rating and expiry at formal H1.
gaps.conclusion: A full-note identity requires a new or materially rewritten contract after H1; it must not be an in-place label change.

gaps.topic: Source governance and explicit gap consumption
gaps.reference_requirement: Every valuation-material claim resolves to a source or explicit block, and every material gap is consumed by a restriction, sensitivity, or monitor in R1.
gaps.yahua_status: Source registry, claim audit, source exhaustion log, and G01-G05 coverage gaps already exist for the event study.
gaps.conclusion: Immediately deepen allowed-method, blocked-method, sensitivity, and owner fields. This prevents fake precision but does not create missing operating inputs.

gaps.topic: Historical financial, segment, balance-sheet, and cash baseline
gaps.reference_requirement: Official financial history, current interim data, segments, cash flow, debt, capex, customer advances, and share/perimeter reconciliation form the model baseline.
gaps.yahua_status: 2023A-2025A and 2026Q1 financials are verified; company card includes 2025 lithium/civil-explosives baseline, negative OCF, and inventory. Formal H1 revenue, cash flow, balance sheet, inventory, and capex are not disclosed.
gaps.conclusion: Historical segment, debt, tax, minority-interest, share-count, capex, and working-capital schedules can be built now; H1 forecast inputs remain unavailable until official results.

gaps.reference_requirement: The reference model bridges operating drivers to revenue, gross profit, opex, parent net profit, EPS, cash conversion, and sensitivities without converting backlog directly into earnings.
gaps.yahua_status: Current model and segment bridge explicitly stop before H2/FY EPS because formal H1 has no disclosed lithium volume, ASP, unit cost, segment profit, civil-explosives order/collection, or cash-conversion bridge.
gaps.conclusion: Formal H1 must support a volume/product-mix x realised-ASP minus cost bridge plus civil-explosives revenue/margin/collection, tax, minority-interest, and OCF/working-capital checks. H1 is necessary but not sufficient if those fields remain undisclosed.

gaps.topic: Value-chain, customer, resource, and order valuation credit
gaps.reference_requirement: Relationship and customer records have row-level provenance, economics, blocked methods, allowed valuation use, and required sensitivity; unverified order/customer claims cannot become valuation credit.
gaps.yahua_status: Current evidence correctly assigns zero or verification-only credit to utilisation, unit costs, customer allocation, self-supply rate, civil-explosives orders, and collections.
gaps.conclusion: Immediately enrich row provenance and usage restrictions. Named-customer revenue, actual self-supply, and project order data remain zero-credit until issuer/customer primary disclosure appears.

gaps.topic: Street comparison and external forecast discipline
gaps.reference_requirement: Original/official broker sources retain forecast, rating, target, method, source quality, source path, and valuation weight; weak evidence receives zero weight.
gaps.yahua_status: Three original broker PDFs are archived with EPS forecasts; all current valuation weights are zero and Dongwu's CNY42 target is explicitly a single external view.
gaps.conclusion: Source normalization, share-basis comparison, forecast-revision table, and coverage refresh plan can be done now. External forecasts or a single target cannot be converted into a house target before G04/G09 pass.

gaps.reference_requirement: Use raw adjusted K-line paths, dated OHLCV/turnover, margin, Connect/fund frequency boundaries, Dragon-Tiger queries, source tier, and limitations for every published market statement.
gaps.yahua_status: Current analysis intentionally limits itself to a 20-day price/turnover event snapshot and explicitly says that index/peer, seat, northbound, margin, and fund data were not collected.
gaps.conclusion: This evidence pack can be collected now with frequency and availability limits. It improves positioning and monitoring only; it does not substitute for formal-H1 economics or add target-price credit.

gaps.topic: House FY scenarios, implied expectations, and sensitivity
gaps.reference_requirement: Independent Bear/Base/Bull operating and cash scenarios produce multi-year revenue, margin, parent net profit, EPS, implied expectations, and downgrade thresholds.
gaps.yahua_status: No house scenarios exist by design; only a mechanical current-price versus external-EPS cross-check is permitted.
gaps.conclusion: After G04, scenarios must identify volume, ASP, cost, civil-explosives revenue/margin/collection, tax, minority interest, and cash assumptions. H1 x2, spot lithium, design capacity, or customer names are not substitute drivers.

gaps.topic: Multi-anchor valuation, target price, and action
gaps.reference_requirement: Reproducible price/share/market-cap inputs, forecasts, method fit, bear/base/bull, intrinsic/market/Street anchors, weights, fair range/target, upside, catalysts, and invalidation are required; Model Reproducibility must pass.
gaps.yahua_status: Current target, upside, and house EPS fields are null; 6.38-8.35x PE only expresses current price divided by external EPS and is not valuation.
gaps.conclusion: Publish valuation only after G04/G08 pass and all valuation arithmetic can reproduce. Otherwise the correct post-H1 result remains watchlist only / insufficient evidence, not a placeholder target.

gaps.topic: House view, risk, current-PDF R0-R4, and final signoff
gaps.reference_requirement: The reference aligns house view, variant perception, risk framework, current PDF, R0-R4, signoff, case verifier, and shared gate for the same report version.
gaps.yahua_status: Current house view and signoff are correctly event-only; the 19-page PDF expires at formal H1 and cannot certify a later full note.
gaps.conclusion: Drafting questions can occur now. Full-note recommendation, current-PDF signoff, R0-R4, and both verifiers must be rebuilt against the H1-after model, not inherited from the event study.

gaps.topic: Deliverable structure, rendering, and version-bound visual evidence
gaps.reference_requirement: The full-note contract requires a 40-60-page Chinese IC deliverable with model, valuation, market, risk, evidence appendix, rendered-page inspection, and final-signoff binding to the current PDF.
gaps.yahua_status: Template brief, exhibit plan, and narrative blueprint are intentionally designed for the 19-page event study, whose visual review passed for that report type.
gaps.conclusion: Future full-note structure and exhibits may be planned now, but a full-note PDF, render set, text snapshot, hash, and visual review must be generated only from the H1-after model and evidence pack; the 19-page event PDF cannot be inflated or re-labelled.

gaps.topic: Shipbuilding-specific operating units and contract economics
gaps.reference_requirement: The reference uses vessel type/price, DWT, yard slots, delivery schedules, classification/acceptance, steel/equipment costs, shipowner advances, military/group orders, and restructuring perimeter controls.
gaps.yahua_status: Yahua's material operating fields are lithium volume/product mix/realised ASP/conversion cost/self-supply and civil-explosives licence utilisation/project execution/collections; many are currently undisclosed.
gaps.conclusion: Do not copy DWT, shipyard, delivery, shipowner-advance, or military-SOTP fields. Transfer only the auditable driver -> revenue -> margin -> cash -> EPS -> valuation-credit control chain.

recommended_sequence: Before H1: complete G02, G03, G05, G06, and G07 as preparation only; preserve the non-rating event-study label.
On formal H1 release: verify income statement, cash flow, balance sheet, receivables, inventory, capex, and segment explanation; record forecast-versus-actual evidence in a new R0 cycle.
After H1: complete G04, G08, and G09 only if unit economics and cash conversion can be reproduced; otherwise issue watchlist only / insufficient evidence.
Full-note publication: use a new full-note contract and rebuild R0-R4, current PDF/render/text evidence, case verifier, and shared research gate for the same H1-after version.
read_only_boundary: This comparison creates no EPS, target price, rating, report-type change, or modification to existing Yahua research artifacts.
